Rumors about iPhone 18 Pro colors have been growing, but thanks to a new leak, we might have our first glimpse at the new color lineup via alleged camera components.

Alleged camera components for iPhone 18 Pro offer first look at potential new colors

Apple has a reputation for valuing secrecy with its unreleased products.

But when you’re producing tens of millions of new iPhones using third-party partners around the world, it’s hard to keep everything locked down.

Last month, a source at Macworld claiming connections to Apple’s supply chain said that iPhone 18 Pro will have four new colors:

  • Silver
  • Light Blue
  • Dark Cherry
  • Dark Gray

Now an image circulating on social media seems to corroborate that color lineup. Here’s a look:

The original source of the image is currently unknown.

9to5Mac’s Take

It’s worth viewing this image with some skepticism, because it’s always possible it was created specifically to match up with the Macworld report.

The Majin account that posted it, for example, appears unlikely to be the same Majin Bu that reputably shared several leaks last year—then later disappeared. Rather than offering original leaks, the new Majin account has largely focused on reposting content sourced elsewhere.

That said, the camera components could very well be legitimate. As Apple moves closer to mass production of iPhone 18 Pro this summer, more parts like this will surface.

Last year, leaker Sonny Dickson shared photos of camera components in July that ended up accurately depicting some of Apple’s iPhone 17 Pro colors. Today’s leak might similarly prove accurate, while arriving earlier than expected.

What do you think of these alleged iPhone 18 Pro colors? Let us know in the comments.
